main.name: Gregory Schnese
main.headline: I make SaaS companies grow.
main.intro: I help SaaS companies grow profitably, by analyzing data and writing the software that turns it into results.
bio: I make SaaS companies grow their profits and help them grow more efficiently. To do this, I analyze data and write software to hit some pretty remarkable targets.

At kikin, a contextual search company, I profitably grew the userbase from 300k to 2mm MAUs. At CoPromote, a marketing service for creators, I increased recurring monthly revenue 4x. I'm currently doing the same things at Fleetio.
main.poker: Did you know the odds of flopping a flush, in hold 'em, are 1:118?
